history.name: One entry, in full
history.description: `ledger show` prints a single feature as it currently stands: where it is filed, its size and readership, its name and any name it had before, its description, its technical notes, what changed about it most recently, and a one-line summary of every release it has moved in. It is what to read before touching an entry — and, with the history asked for in full, the whole story of that capability from the release it first appeared in.
history.dev_notes: cmdShow; --history walks every entry, --json emits the stored record.
